parameters.name: baseline_hash
parameters.description: WorkshopRiskSnapshot.baseline_hash; compare to Gold and Silver before confirmation

parameters.name: result_hash
parameters.description: WorkshopRiskSnapshot.result_hash; must match independently computed option evidence

parameters.name: approval_evidence_ref
parameters.description: If the human has a real Teams approval/message evidence reference, enter it here; otherwise leave empty. This string is not identity verification.

identity_contract.approval_boundary: Platform Proceed/Confirm and verified action binding, not a Python boolean
identity_contract.notebook_limitation: Notebook cannot independently distinguish a creator's direct invocation from a Teams-approved action invocation. Creator execute permissions and platform activity evidence must be reviewed.
identity_contract.external_evidence: Persist provided reference verbatim as externally_supplied_not_verified; empty is not_supplied_by_platform
identity_contract.configured_creator: Administrator verified Entra object ID of agent creator; notebook records it as configured identity, not runtime proof
identity_contract.empty_evidence_parameter: If tenant UI does not accept the documented empty-string default and no actual reference is available, report blocked; never fabricate approval evidence.

concurrency: One serialized action invocation per participant audit; MERGE is not a unique constraint
recovery: Audit and Eventhouse are separate stores. After audit readback, explicitly append recorded status; on sync failure preserve audit, Stop, and retry status only.
